concerns.text: The task T001 (and similarly T002‑T010) is tagged `[P]` but all these tasks use `ResourceMonitor` which appends rows to the shared file `results/monitoring.csv`. Concurrent execution would cause race conditions, so the `[P]` (parallel‑safe) tag is inaccurate.

User‑story block US2 (tasks T006, T007) cannot be run end‑to‑end on its own because it depends on artifacts (embeddings) produced in US1. This violates the rule that each US block must be an independently shippable unit.

User‑story block US3 (tasks T008, T009) also depends on outputs from US1 and US2 (fidelity results, geometric descriptors). Therefore US3 is not independently shippable, breaching the US‑grouping requirement.

The ordering notation `T008 ↔ T009` suggests the two tasks can run in any order, but T009 relies on clustering results from T006 and does not feed T008. Clarify the ordering (e.g., `T008 → T009`) to avoid any potential consumer‑before‑producer ambiguity.
